question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Profuse**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Scarce**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Profuse"** means something that exists or is produced in large quantities; it refers to abundance or excess. (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

 

 
• **Example:** The garden was profuse with vibrant flowers blooming in every corner.

 

 
• **"Scarce"** refers to something that is insufficient, rare, or in short supply; it is the opposite of profuse. (दुर्लभ)

 

 
• **Example:** During the drought, water became scarce in the region.

 

 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Profuse"** is **"Scarce"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Scarce**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Copious** (प्रचुर): Existing in large quantity; abundant.

 

 
• **Example:** She took copious notes during the lecture to ensure she didn’t miss any details.

 

 
• **Abundant** (अधिक): Present in large amounts; more than enough.

 

 
• **Example:** The region is abundant in natural resources like coal and minerals.

 

 
• **Plentiful** (बहुतायत): Exceedingly large in quantity; available in plenty.

 

 
• **Example:** The harvest this year was plentiful due to good rainfall.
